description: Compose Multiplatform integration for the offset variant of the Paginator pagination library. Provides idiomatic bindings between PaginatorPrefetchController and LazyListState / LazyGridState / LazyStaggeredGridState — auto-pagination on scroll without manual snapshotFlow wiring. Pair with paginator-offset; for cursor-based feeds use paginator-compose-cursor instead. Targets Android, iOS, JVM, JS, Wasm.
